g1-implement.title: Blob-OID pin + fail-on-drift: implement
g1-implement.imperative: Fill templates/IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md for this gate: in tests/test_checklist_engine.py, class CommanderSpineBasisFields (~line 8543) ONLY. (1) Replace PINNED_HEAD (whole-repo git rev-parse HEAD) with PINNED_BLOB, the blob OID of skills/commander/templates/COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json via `git rev-parse HEAD:skills/commander/templates/COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json` -- compute this value as the LAST step before this gate's own g1-integrate (never at dispatch time), because a sibling wave-3 lane (w3-promote) owns edits to that exact template file and may land first; pinning early risks shipping an already-stale PINNED_BLOB (critic finding 1). (2) Replace _skip_if_head_moved with _fail_if_template_drifted: on mismatch, call self.fail(...) (never self.skipTest), with a message that names the proof as 'stale', states both the pinned and current blob OIDs, and gives the exact re-run command `git rev-parse HEAD:skills/commander/templates/COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json` as the re-verify path, plus what to do with its output (paste into PINNED_BLOB). Keep the pre-existing self.assertEqual(out.returncode, 0, out.stderr) guard so a git-command failure stays distinct from a genuine drift failure (critic finding 6). (3) Update all 3 test methods' first line from self._skip_if_head_moved() to self._fail_if_template_drifted(); EXPECTED_BASIS and _load_spine are untouched. (4) Rewrite the class docstring's second paragraph (currently 'Pinned to this gate's shipped git HEAD ... If HEAD has moved past the pinned commit, skip rather than assert...') to describe blob-OID pinning to the template file and fail-on-drift, not the retired whole-repo-HEAD + skip design (critic finding 3). (5) Any inline comment on PINNED_BLOB must say 'g1 dispatch', matching this actual gate structure, never 'g2' (critic finding 4). (6) Add a two-direction mutation-battery proof as new test methods on the class (or a sibling test in the same file): (a) template-edit -> RED: in an ISOLATED clone (e.g. `git clone --local . /tmp/<scratch>`, never the shared worktree at /home/tommy/projects/569-w3-basis), mutate one byte of skills/commander/templates/COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json and commit, then run CommanderSpineBasisFields against that clone and assert all 3 tests FAIL (not skip, not error) with messages containing the substring 'proof is stale' and the literal command string 'git rev-parse HEAD:skills/commander/templates/COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json'; (b) unrelated-commit -> GREEN: same isolated clone, commit a change to a file outside skills/commander/templates/, run CommanderSpineBasisFields, assert all 3 tests PASS. Tear down the scratch clone afterward (critic finding 2). Dispatch a subagent invoking constellation-implementer with the completed handoff. Wait for and integrate the returned IMPLEMENTER_RESULT as evidence: `spine_evidence` with `action=attach`, `task_id=g1-implement`, `evidence_type=implementer-result`, `fields={status: <value>}`, `<value>` copied verbatim from the returned IMPLEMENTER_RESULT's Return status field, lowercase.

g1-review.title: Blob-OID pin + fail-on-drift: review
g1-review.imperative: Fill templates/REVIEWER_HANDOFF.template.md: what was implemented, how to inspect the diff, task statement, close criteria, allowed scope (tests/test_checklist_engine.py only), specific exclusions (no template edits, no scripts/checklist_engine.py edits), constraints, the inbound anchors from g1-implement's anchors block, and the evidence from IMPLEMENTER_RESULT. The reviewer independently re-derives the current blob OID via `git rev-parse HEAD:skills/commander/templates/COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json` and confirms it matches PINNED_BLOB; confirms the fail message contains all four required elements (stale, both OIDs, the exact re-run command, the paste-target instruction); confirms the class docstring no longer describes the retired whole-repo-HEAD + skip design; confirms the mutation battery runs against an isolated clone (not the shared worktree) and both directions (RED on template edit, GREEN on unrelated commit) actually pass when run; confirms the rev-parse-failure path and the drift-fail path remain distinct (critic finding 6); confirms no file outside tests/test_checklist_engine.py changed. Dispatch a subagent invoking constellation-reviewer with the completed handoff. Wait for and integrate the returned REVIEW_RESULT as evidence.
